CVE-2026-44903 is a stored XSS in Prometheus's old web UI heatmap display, triggered through crafted histogram bucket label values. KEDA consumes prometheus as a library for its scalers and metrics parsing and does not serve the Prometheus web UI.

GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28 (CVE-2026-44903) was fixed in the 3.5.x LTS line in v3.5.3. This image builds from upstream v3.5.5 (Go module v0.305.5), which includes escapeHTML for le label values in the legacy heatmap tick labels. The advisory scope is limited to the legacy web UI enabled with --enable-feature=old-ui; this image does not pass that flag. Scout matches because the advisory records a single Go-module fixed version of 0.311.3 rather than the LTS backport.

GHSA-vffh-x6r8-xx99 (CVE-2026-40179) was fixed in the 3.5.x LTS line in v3.5.2. This image builds from upstream v3.5.5 (Go module v0.305.5) and compiles the patched web UI where metric names and label values are escaped before innerHTML insertion. Scout matches because the advisory records a single Go-module fixed version of 0.311.2-0.20260410083055-07c6232d159b rather than the LTS backport.

CVE-2026-42154 affects unauthenticated requests to the Prometheus remote-read HTTP endpoint (/api/v1/read), implemented by the Prometheus remote read server handler. Kapacitor v1.8.6 links Prometheus discovery, config, scrape, and TSDB helper packages but the kapacitord dependency graph does not include github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote, web, or web/api/v1, and source inspection shows no remote-read handler or /api/v1/read route. The vulnerable Prometheus server handler is not present in the Kapacitor binary.

Vulnerable code is the Prometheus legacy web UI (old-ui); Grafana vendors prometheus only for its alerting backend and never builds or serves the web UI.

The vulnerable code is entirely in the Prometheus web UI frontend (React/Mantine TypeScript under web/ui/ and the vendored jquery.flot.heatmap.js), which renders unescaped metric names and label values via innerHTML. Grafana vendors the Prometheus Go module only for its alerting backend (PromQL, TSDB, model); it does not build, bundle, or serve the Prometheus web UI. The affected frontend code is never compiled into or executed by the Grafana binary, so the stored XSS is not reachable in this image.

CVE-2026-44903 (GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28) is a stored XSS in the Prometheus server's legacy web UI heatmap, which is only rendered when the prometheus binary is launched with --enable-feature=old-ui. Loki 3.7.x imports github.com/prometheus/prometheus/web/api/v1 only for the PrometheusVersion struct (version reporting in pkg/loki/version_handler.go, pkg/util/build/build.go, pkg/analytics/*); the legacy web UI templates and heatmap render path are not imported or compiled into the Loki binary. Loki 3.7 cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

CVE-2026-42154 affects the Prometheus server's remote-read HTTP handler (/api/v1/read), which uses a snappy decoder that does not validate declared payload length before allocating memory. Loki 3.7.x uses github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote only on the client side (pkg/ruler/storage/instance/instance.go calls remote.NewStorage for the ruler WAL) and never instantiates remote.NewReadHandler or routes /api/v1/read in its HTTP server, so the vulnerable handler is not reachable in the Loki binary. Loki 3.7 cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

CVE-2026-42151 affects the Prometheus server's /api/v1/status/config endpoint failing to redact the Azure AD remote-write OAuth client_secret field. Loki 3.7.x vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote/azuread transitively via config and storage/remote/client, but does not expose /api/v1/status/config or any equivalent endpoint that serializes its remote-write configuration back over HTTP, so the vulnerable config-display path is unreachable in the Loki binary. Loki 3.7 cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE in Prometheus because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

CVE-2026-44903 affects the Prometheus server legacy web UI heatmap rendering path. GHSA-8rm2-7qqf-34qm (CVE-2026-42154) is a DoS on the /api/v1/read endpoint via an unvalidated snappy-decoded length. The fix was backported to the 3.5.x LTS line in v3.5.2 (Go module v0.305.2) and shipped for the 3.x line in v3.11.3 (Go module v0.311.3); the shipped v3.5.5 (Go module v0.305.5) compiles the patched code that validates the declared length before allocating. Scout flags the whole 0.305.x range because the advisory records a single 3.x fixed version of 0.311.3, so matches against the patched 3.5.x builds are false positives.

CVE-2026-44903 is classified by Scout as Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (cross-site scripting) in Prometheus's web UI, same vulnerability class as GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28 and the same fixed version (0.311.3). Pyroscope ships its own React-based UI under / and /explore and does not register Prometheus's web/ui templates or call prometheus/web.New, so the vulnerable rendering paths are not reachable. No public NVD or GHSA advisory is available at the time of writing; Prometheus 3.11.3 release notes only list CVE-2026-42151, CVE-2026-42154, and GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28. If a published advisory later reveals a non-web-UI code path, this statement will need to be replaced.

GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28 is a cross-site scripting issue in Prometheus's web UI templates (/graph, /alerts, /rules). Pyroscope ships its own React-based UI under / and /explore and does not register Prometheus's web/ui templates or call prometheus/web.New, so the vulnerable rendering paths are not reachable. Note: pyroscope's source imports prometheus/web/api/v1 in pkg/usagestats and pkg/util/build for type-only access to the PrometheusVersion struct, which puts the package in the SBOM without instantiating any handlers. Same upstream fix line as CVE-2026-42151 / CVE-2026-42154; bump infeasible for 1.15-1.20.

CVE-2026-42154 is a snappy decompression DoS reachable through Prometheus's remote_read server handler (/api/v1/read). Pyroscope imports storage/remote only as a remote-write client (remote.NewWriteClient in pkg/metrics/exporter.go); the vulnerable remote.NewReadHandler is never constructed and no /api/v1/read route is registered. The fixed version v0.311.3 is incompatible with pyroscope 1.15-1.20's code (parser.ParseMetricSelector API removed); the bump only lands cleanly on pyroscope 1.21+, which is tracked separately.

CVE-2026-42151 exposes the Azure-AD remote-write client_secret via Prometheus's /-/config admin endpoint. Pyroscope does not run a Prometheus server: pkg/api/api.go registers only pyroscope's own routes (/ingest, /pyroscope/*, /api/v1/status/* via pyroscope's statusv1 proto service, etc.) and never instantiates prometheus/web.Handler, so /-/config is not routed. The fixed version v0.311.3 is incompatible with pyroscope 1.15-1.20's code (parser.ParseMetricSelector API removed); the bump only lands cleanly on pyroscope 1.21+, which is tracked separately.
